verdict.rationale: Lovable's built-in Cloud backend provisions a database automatically alongside the app, and users describe schema/tables in chat to have Lovable create them, with a SQL editor for direct access — all inside the builder with no external setup. Community evidence corroborates real usage of Lovable-built backends (e.g., internal CRUD tools/dashboards) though with quality caveats about generated code. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation specifically of the database-provisioning flow (vs. general backend criticism), and detail on schema migration/versioning workflow.
